title: nametagcrafts
description: This datapack adds the ability to craft nametags for 1.21.x.
body:
# nametagcrafts
![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/nogai3/nametagcrafts)
![Enviroment Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/environment-server-1976d2?style=flat-square)
![Enviroment Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/environment-client-1976d2?style=flat-square)

Datapack allowing you to create nametags for versions 1.21.x

---
## 📖 How install?

When creating a world, select the data packs menu and drag our data pack into the folder that opens or open the folder with the already created world, select the datapack folder and drag our archive there, then type: /datapack enable (the game will suggest the datapack itself)
